faqs.question: Why does our Wi-Fi drop in some areas of the office?
faqs.answer: Usually a single router can't cover the whole space. We plan access points based on your layout so coverage is consistent everywhere.

faqs.question: Can you set up separate Wi-Fi for guests?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure a separate guest network so visitors never access your internal systems.

faqs.question: What is a PoE switch and do I need one?
faqs.answer: PoE switches power devices like CCTV cameras and access points over the network cable. They simplify installation when you have many such devices.
